# wso2is_api_resource (Data Source)

Looks up an API resource by ID, identifier or name. This includes the built-in management APIs, for example the APIs with the identifiers `/api/server/v1/applications` or `/scim2/Users`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a management API to authorize an application for it.
data "wso2is_api_resource" "applications_api" {
  identifier = "/api/server/v1/applications"
}

output "application_management_scopes" {
  value = data.wso2is_api_resource.applications_api.scope_names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) API resource ID.
- `identifier` (String) Identifier, for example `https://api.example.com` or `/api/server/v1/applications`.
- `name` (String) Display name.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description.
- `requires_authorization` (Boolean) Whether applications need authorization to request its scopes.
- `scope_ids` (Map of String) Scope IDs by name.
- `scope_names` (Set of String) All scope names, handy for authorizing every scope.
- `scopes` (Attributes Set) Scopes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scopes))
- `type` (String) Type: `BUSINESS`, `TENANT`, `ORGANIZATION`, `SYSTEM`, `CONSOLE_FEATURE`, ...

<a id="nestedatt--scopes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scopes`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description.
- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `name` (String) Scope name.
